Name: Window Control
Description: Scroll & focus windows from the Ulanzi dial, plus komorebi tiling controls on the knob and keys.

Actions.Name: Window Switcher
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to scroll windows, press to focus the selected one

Actions.Name: komorebi Focus
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to cycle komorebi focus, press to toggle monocle (focus big / out)

Actions.Name: Window Filter
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle the Window Switcher between terminals-only and all windows

Actions.Name: komorebi Command
Actions.Tooltip: Run a chosen komorebic command (retile, float, pause, layout, …)
